explanation: The Maracanã stadium staged the opening ceremony. Brazil's men also won their first Olympic football (soccer) gold there, beating Germany on penalties.

claims.text: The 2016 Summer Olympics in Rio de Janeiro were the first Olympic Games held in South America.
The 2008, 2012 and 2020 Summer Olympics were held in Beijing, London and Tokyo, none of them in South America.
The opening ceremony of the Rio Olympics was held at the Maracanã stadium.
At the 2016 Olympics Brazil won its first Olympic gold medal in men's football (soccer), beating Germany on penalties in the final at the Maracanã.
